invoice-preview-using-stale-template-dat.description: Invoice Preview shows stale template data after editing in Style Editor. Root cause: Template Preview uses Zustand store (currentTemplate) with instant updates, while Invoice Preview uses Convex query via useTemplates() which is cached for 60 seconds. Solution: When Invoice Preview displays a template being edited in Style Editor, use the Zustand store's currentTemplate instead of the cached Convex version.

changes: After line 42: Add import { useTemplateStore } from '@/lib/template-store'
After line 78: Add const { currentTemplate: storeTemplate, getConvexTemplateId } = useTemplateStore(); const storeTemplateConvexId = getConvexTemplateId();
Lines 143-151: Update selectedPreviewTemplate useMemo to check if viewing template currently being edited in Style Editor and use store version if so

stepsToVerify: Open Style Editor with a user template
Change a property (e.g., set row height to 'auto')
Navigate to an invoice and open Invoice Preview
Select the same template in the style selector
Verify the preview shows the updated value (matching Template Preview)
